# redfish_account (Resource)

Adopts an existing account of the Redfish AccountService by user name and manages whether it is enabled and its role. It never creates or deletes accounts and never touches passwords: destroying the resource only removes it from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adopts the existing account "monitor" and disables it. Destroy only removes it from state.
resource "redfish_account" "monitor" {
  redfish_server { redfish_alias = "bmc" }
  username = "monitor"
  enabled  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) User name of the existing account.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account may log in.
- `redfish_server` (Block List) List of server BMCs and their respective user credentials (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--redfish_server))
- `role_id` (String) Role of the account, e.g. Administrator, Operator, ReadOnly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Redfish URI of the account.

<a id="nestedblock--redfish_server"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redfish_server`

Optional:

- `endpoint` (String) Server BMC IP address or hostname
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password for login
- `redfish_alias` (String) Alias name for server BMCs. The key in provider's `redfish_servers` map
- `ssl_insecure` (Boolean) This field indicates whether the SSL/TLS certificate must be verified or not
- `user` (String) User name for login
